title: Chapter 518
text:
Players could move about in Godora's camp, but the core area was not open to them. Godora's soldiers had blocked the players outside.

The two of them walked into the room and sat down.

"How's the situation with the disaster relief?" Han Xiao smiled.

"The situation is getting better, and order is slowly being restored. The information you gave us was a great help. Not only Blue Star, but the other disaster relief teams on the other planets also acted according to the information. The situation is very stable. As long as the scale of the disaster is under control, the rest of the problem is waiting for the research department to develop a complete antidote."

Speaking of serious matters, Nagojin's expression became serious.

Then, the two of them discussed the situation of Blue Star's disaster relief in depth, pointing out the current difficulties and management problems. After talking for a long time, Han Xiao pretended to casually ask, "Oh right, when I came over just now, I saw you guys recruiting Inhumans."

"Haha, yes." Nagojin was very straightforward and did not hide anything. "I didn't expect Blue Star to have such a strange phenomenon. After some observation, I realized that they indeed have a lot of potential. No wonder you've been recruiting them. We're also preparing to recruit some Inhumans."

Han Xiao touched his chin and did not show any emotions. "Yes, I've known the Inhumans for a long time. Your investigators also did not understand the reason for their existence. Later on, they saw that their actions were no different from normal people, so they did not find it strange anymore. Indeed, they have potential, and their numbers are considerable."

"Oh right, you have a high reputation among the Inhumans. Can you help?" Nagojin's eyes lit up. He felt that he could ask Black Star for help.

He saw that the Black Star Mercenary did not accept all the Inhumans but conducted a selection process. He thought that Black Star did not actually want to monopolize all the Inhumans, so he should not be angry. Furthermore, Han Xiao's calm attitude confirmed his thoughts. At this time, Nagojin was even more relieved and asked for help.

Han Xiao's expression was a little strange. Is this too much? Not only are you trying to poach my people, but you also want me to teach you how to use a hoe well?

His expression did not change as he nodded and said, "I can give you some suggestions, but I can't guarantee that they will be effective. After all, the Inhumans are not my subordinates."

Nagojin thought for a moment and said, "What method did you use to make those mutants so eager to join your mercenary group?"

Han Xiao chuckled. "Actually, it's nothing much. It's just the same as what you guys are doing. Introduce the background of the mercenary group, the structure of the galaxy, and mention the benefits. The rest is up to the Inhumans. As long as you continue to spread Godora's background, you will definitely attract some people."

"I think so too." Nagojin nodded. His plan was not wrong. It was just that Black Star had beaten him to it.

Since the direction was correct, Nagojin was not prepared to change his approach. Compared to a mercenary group, it was naturally better to join the Godora Civilization. It seemed like he only needed time to slowly let the Inhumans understand this point.

After chatting for a while, Han Xiao said goodbye and walked out of Godora's camp. He shook his head and laughed secretly.

Actually, Nagojin's guess was not wrong. He was not angry because he already knew that Godora would be his competitor. Nagojin's actions were within his expectations. Originally, there was another competitor, Dark-star. However, as the Germinal Organization was long gone, Dark-star would not appear for the time being. Furthermore, he was tied to Godora, so Dark-star was almost out of the game. He had one less competitor.

Han Xiao was clear about Nagojin's recruitment process. There was nothing special about it. It was just like what he was doing now. It was nothing more than introducing one's background. However, at that time, the players could only choose between good and evil. What was different from his previous life was that there was a new option for the lawful side, the Black Star Mercenary. Therefore, Godora could not monopolize the market.

After being active among the players for a long time, Nagojin could easily shake his position in the hearts of the players. Han Xiao could only encourage them to continue sleeping.

Even if Godora gave out all kinds of benefits, their core competitiveness was far inferior to his. Pork Bun had released so many videos, which had a huge effect. It allowed the players to have a clear understanding of the Black Star Mercenary. Furthermore, it also caused the players to look forward to it. The serial-like mode formed a preliminary sense of belonging.

Benefits, he had the advantage. Feelings, he had the advantage. Interest, he still had the advantage. He had all the advantages, but he did not know how to lose. On the path of collecting leeks, Godora was like a younger brother.

Because he was well-prepared, he had a strong foundation. There was no need for him to do anything, and Godora would not be able to do anything.

Furthermore, in theory, the players could indeed join both sides at the same time. From Han Xiao's point of view, the real choice would appear when they left the planet. At that time, the players would have to choose who to follow. Therefore, he was not in a hurry at all.

When the players had to choose between the two sides, he would definitely have the absolute advantage. Furthermore, with the crowd effect, more players would choose him. It was almost like a moving Main City!

On the other hand, Godora's side would definitely be cold and desolate.

However, Han Xiao never complained about having more tricks up his sleeve. Even if he had an obvious advantage, he would not sit back and do nothing. He secretly thought of a countermeasure.

Godora is still a collaborator, so I can't openly fall out with them. That would be too irrational. Although Godora's competitiveness is not as good as mine, there are thousands of players. There will definitely be some who will choose them. I don't need to care. As long as the scale of the mercenary group reaches my expectations, it will be enough. Hmm, after this matter is over, Blue Star can establish a mercenary group base. In the future, there will be an endless stream of new people …

Han Xiao pinched his chin and pondered for a while. He had already thought of two ways to deal with this situation.

As for the countermeasure, the first is to increase my attractiveness. Now, the players basically know the benefits that I can give them, but there is still room for improvement. If I want the players to follow the mercenary group into the galaxy, I have to make them feel reluctant … Heh, very simple.

Han Xiao chuckled lightly. He immediately had an idea. Just like the Sky Ring Army's rank system, he could implement a direct rank system for the Black Star Mercenary.

For example, when the total amount of contribution points accumulated by the players reached a certain value (including the contribution points spent), they would be able to reach a new rank. He should give these ranks different honorary titles and record them in the mercenary files of the players.

Other than giving the players a sense of achievement, there were also practical benefits. For example, when they reached a certain rank, they would be able to obtain different discounts when purchasing faction products. This way, the players would not be willing to give up their previous accumulation, mainly because they could not bear to spend money. This would naturally increase the attractiveness and sense of belonging of the faction.

The achievement system is also the key to a faction. It is equivalent to the organizational structure of the faction. There are more and more people, so I'll set it up after some time to make it easier to manage. Oh, I also have to think of some cool titles for the ranks.

Han Xiao flicked his tongue and made a sound. He was in a good mood. He was the best at coming up with names.

Other than increasing his attractiveness, another countermeasure was naturally to attack his competitors.

Since he could not openly fight with Godora, he could only do things behind their backs. His only choice was to use public opinion as a weapon.

Han Xiao immediately had a target.

The players' forum was the best platform for public opinion. It was only circulated among the players, and it was hidden and easy to use. Even if Godora was schemed against, the other party would not know what happened.

He rolled his eyes and chuckled. "Looks like I'll have to use the meat bun."

…

At night, in the core area of the sanctuary, a group of players was rushing to Han Xiao's residence. Mad Blade, Pork Bun, Hao Tian, and Maple Moon received the notice. They were the first four to receive special treatment.

"Black Star suddenly summoned us. I wonder what's going on."

Not long ago, their interface had suddenly triggered a faction mission. They were required to find Han Xiao immediately, and the reward was generous. The few of them did not delay and immediately set off after forming a team.

When they arrived, Han Xiao, who was dressed in black, appeared in front of the four of them. He nodded expressionlessly and greeted them. After making many turns, they arrived outside a secret interrogation room. They were shocked to find Bennett there as well.

This Blue Star protagonist type character was known to almost everyone. Mad Blade and the others felt that things were not simple when two big shots appeared at the same time.

"What do we need to do?" Maple Moon could not help but ask.

Han Xiao turned around and said slowly, "A few days ago, we caught a person. The information we found was too shocking, so we interrogated him dozens of times. You guys are my trusted partners, so I need you to interrogate him again."

As he spoke, he gave the four of them a new mission called "Interrogation Mission". He put in all the rewards for the day, and it was very generous.

When the four of them heard this, they subconsciously turned around. Through the single-sided glass of the interrogation room, they saw the interrogation target in the room.
